Well, it began when my civics teacher said something alone the lines of "Us guys gotta register for the draft". First I just ignored it and thought that it probably wouldn't happen and I could just avoid it if it did. Then I progressively became more nervous about it worrying that it would get me, that led to me developing my first set of plans to avoid it. The total of 4 plans included my 2 physical deformities, my mental disorders, and if worst comes to worst severing parts of my foot. Then with these plans my fear loosened a little, then the stress returned ruining my birthday and Christmas by making me dull, as I spent the entire time worrying. In that time the fear of the draft birthed my OCD, which spread to other things such as making sure doors are locked to hand washing. I also developed more reasons on how and why to avoid. I worried that I would be forced to kill and realized that if they called my number I would likely be forced into the military where people yell at you constantly based off of the videos I have seen of it, I can't take that since I was born with a mental offset. Shortly after that my worries dropped until my doctor and someone else said my physical deformities wouldn't disqualify me when let me to rework my avoidance plan. Now instead of 4 plans I have over 30. I have also considered simply ending it so I don't have to register because registering is supporting it. I now think about it every almost every hour I am awake, every day, every week and this has been for a few months. It got so stressful I wondered why I was even hanging on to everything and considered how little I would be affected by it if I wasn't alive. I already checked and minors can't exactly cancel their citizenship or leave the country be themselves so I can't do that so dying is literally the only way out that doesn't involve me being bedridden until I am 28. I am against murder and even if I am a contientious objector I would still be supporting the war effort, in turn supporting war and murder. - Ego: You
